name: Linden Tools
purpose: Neighbours on Linden Row list the tools they're happy to lend and borrow each other's for a few days, instead of asking in a WhatsApp group where requests get lost or buying tools they use twice a year.

collects.why: So the neighbours who have joined know whose tools they are, and who is asking to borrow one.
collects.kept: Until the person deletes their account.

collects.why: To send them sign-in links. Neighbours don't see it.
collects.kept: Until the person deletes their account.

collects.what: Each person's house number on Linden Row, just the number.
collects.why: So neighbours know which house to go to for a tool, and where to bring it back.
collects.kept: Until the person deletes their account.

collects.what: The tools each person lists, and when they listed them.
collects.why: So the neighbours who have joined can see what they could borrow.
collects.kept: Until the person removes the tool, or deletes their account.

collects.what: Loans: who asked to borrow which tool from whom, and when it was asked for, lent, returned, declined or withdrawn.
collects.why: So the lender and the borrower, the only two people who see a loan, can keep track of the tool.
collects.kept: A year after the loan ends; a request nobody answers, a year after it was made; a tool still lent out stays on record until it is back. Deleted at once with either person's account.

collects.what: Sign-in links: the email address a link was sent to, whether it is for joining or signing in, and when it was made. Only a hash of the link's code is stored.
collects.why: To let people join and sign in with a link sent by email, without a password.
collects.kept: Until it is used, or for 15 minutes; an unused one is deleted within the hour after.

collects.what: Sessions: when a person signed in, and when that session ends. The session's code is in a cookie on their device; only its hash is stored.
collects.why: To keep a person signed in.
collects.kept: 30 days, or until they sign out or delete their account; an ended one is deleted within the hour after.

sharedWith.who: Hetzner: a small server in Germany that Mira rents
sharedWith.what: Everything in data.collects: the database is a file on the server, in Hetzner's data centre, and visits reach it through Hetzner's network. Mira, who runs the server, could read all of it, loans included.
sharedWith.why: To run Linden Tools and keep its database.

sharedWith.what: A person's email address, and the email with their sign-in link, each time they ask for one.
sharedWith.why: To send sign-in links by email. Only when the server's environment holds a Resend key; without one, nothing is sent.

data.export: Signed in, open Your account and choose Download everything about you: one JSON file with your account, your tools, every loan you are part of, and your sign-in links and sessions.
data.delete: Signed in, open Your account and choose Delete your account: it deletes your account, email address, house number, tools, every loan you were part of, and your sign-in links and sessions, at once.
